name: Nicholas Begich
bio: a Representative from Alaska; born in Anchorage, Alaska, October 21, 1977; graduated from The Master's Academy, Oviedo, Fla., 1995; B.B.A., Baylor University, Waco, Tex., 1999; M.B.A., Indiana University, Bloomington, Ind., 2002; business owner; entrepreneur; investor; unsuccessful candidate for special election to the One Hundred Seventeenth Congress in 2022; unsuccessful candidate for election to the One Hundred Eighteenth Congress in 2022; elected as a Republican to the One Hundred Nineteenth Congress (January 3, 2025-present).
